subject: ROUNDED phrase
notes: 'If the MODE phrase is not specified, the form of rounding is as described in 11.9.6, DEFAULT ROUNDED clause.' RoundingOf returns ctx.Options.DefaultRounding for a bare ROUNDED (NEAREST-AWAY-FROM-ZERO absent the clause, §11.9.6.3 GR2 'DEFAULT ROUNDED MODE IS NEAREST-AWAY-FROM-ZERO is implied'). Probes: bare ROUNDED of -2.5 into S9 at --std 85 and 2002 -> -3; with DEFAULT ROUNDED MODE IS TOWARD-LESSER, COMPUTE R1 ROUNDED = -1.25 into S9V9 -> -1.3. Both halves pinned by goldens: options_default_rounded (clause present, NEAREST-EVEN: 2.5->2, 3.5->4, 0.5->0) and rounded_modes DEFLT (clause absent, 2.25->2.3). cite.py --check 14.7.4.3 -> OK §14.7.4.3 1); --check 11.9.6.3 -> OK §11.9.6.3 2).
